title: GUTS - The Genesis of a Tragic Hero (Berserk analysis)
summary: A narrated analysis of Guts's childhood in Berserk: born under a hangman's tree, raised by mercenaries under the abusive Gambino, sold to a rapist by his adoptive father, and forced to kill him. NH frames it as the genesis of the Black Swordsman and an exploration of trauma, delusion and the cycle of violence.
claims: Young Guts used sword training and physical exhaustion as an escape from existential pain, sleeping with his sword as a coping mechanism
Guts's drive to earn Gambino's approval, reinforced by rare moments of kindness, was a powerful motivator despite the abuse
Guts built a delusion that Gambino could not have betrayed him because he could not face the truth
Trauma may be alleviated by time but is never fully gone, and can resurface on any given day
Killing an innocent page completes Guts's cycle from molested child to child murderer and gives birth to the 'beast of darkness'
